ns2:section.sectionText: This course will open to all students in the Gies College of Business on Monday, November 18, 2019 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This course will open to Informatics Minors on Monday, November 25, 2019 at approximately 10:00 a.m. BUSINESS MINOR/PROSPECTIVE BUSINESS MINOR STUDENTS: This section will not open to you since all students are required to take the online option, if offered, as stated on the Business Minor website. BADM 350 is offered online in the summer and winter terms. No exceptions will be made. There are currently 5 reserved seats for GIes College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, January 24, 2020 at approximately 10:00 a.m. Any exchange students outside of Gies College of Business that register will be removed from the course. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
